the eve of a quarter of a century. both a blessing and a curse. i don’t think i wrote last year, but 25 feels special, or a milestone, even though there are no cards in the supermarket specifically for the age of 25. tonight feels a bit… anticlimactic. my life at this age is very different to how i pictured it even a couple of years ago. by 25, i thought i would have my life figured out, a career, marriage and a family. 

that sounds insane to me right now. but it also sounds kind of nice, i guess. homely. the grass is airway greener, right?

i don’t know how i feel about this last year of being 24. i’ve had two jobs, i was unemployed, i’ve essentially coasted but not quite enough to be in a better position. i have made good friends, although.. have i? i have the same friends i did when i was 23 but i have solidified these friendships. 

there’s no songs i know on spotify about 25 or with that number in. maybe i am getting old. 

i’m spending the day with █████ in london tomorrow. i think it will be good, but i’ve had some weird vibes from her lately. we haven’t seen each other in a month. i also know i have a tendency to remove friends when they become a struggle. so i think tomorrow will be either really good, or not so great. i just don’t want to be dragged down on the one day that i can call my own. 

how am i feeling about turning 25? i think it is really scary. i still feel like i missed a couple of years of my life, i feel more connected to the age of 23. there’s a lot of things i wish i could change right now. i feel quite emotional tonight. i am way in the depths of a quarter life crisis, i am struggling with direction and with  who i am and who i am meant to be. this year, i would like to embark on solo travel and see where it takes me. i am not sure if this would be a long term or short term thing, but it needs to be done. i feel an urge to just go, and explore myself and the world. it feels like a rite of passage, it feels right in general. but i don’t want to think to deep on it like i did with canada. which, isn’t doable. i cannot justify leaving next month. but, i have friends that are going. so i am not missing out completely. 

the prospect of solo travelling, especially as a female, sounds really scary. but, i have nothing for me here. i am in a job that, while cushty, is not great for my mental health and i feel extremely isolated. there’s quite a few countries i have in mind. but i think i just need to book the flight and then see where it takes me. i have a budget, of course. and i’ll need to have enough left so i can go straight into renting when i am home. or will i ever come home? don’t want to think too far ahead. i just no i have to go. 

so, where do i want to be this year? i am not sure. by 26, i definitely want to have left home. i want to be more financially independent (i am right now, but with the addition of living at home, of course things are a bit easier). by the end of the year, i would like to have some sort of start to a stable relationship with longevity. i want to be travelling and i want to not have to be working in an office. oh, god, how i wish to not be working in an office. or maybe at least, not this one. i want to have a platform that is entirely my own, i just need to figure out what that is. but i am not where i want to be right now. i just need to figure that out. 

and god, it is so hard! to be an artist, a creative, to be anything other than our bog-standard rat-race of the 9-5, it is really hard to accomplish those means. i am not a child of nepotism, or wealth, or connections. how does one find the balance of working and slacking? should i cut myself some slack or am i not doing enough? i don’t know. maybe i do need to stop being so hard on myself. everyone tells me i am so young, but it feels like i should have my life together by now. your twenties are really fucking weird. i still feel 18, i feel a lot younger than i am and i think i come across as younger, too. i miss my days at uni, i think i peaked at that time. but i also have been thinking lately: did i romanticise that time before █? i listen to my playlists from that time and i feel so authentically myself. but then, maybe it is just a romanticising of an era. a period that i know i cannot go back to, no matter how hard i try. i admire myself, then. do i admire myself now? i don’t know. i just feel like i haven’t accomplished enough. at least, not in the way i had expected. 

i suppose in a lot of ways, i have done really well. i have become so independent this year. i have at least tripled my salary and have a position that is beyond my means and that is the starting point in a career. but is it a career i want? 

i just cannot see myself in an office. but what other way? i have no creative stills on paper. i have no other means to go by. 

i need to get out. i think that it all that it is. i need to get out, or i will be out. i will be so far out of myself that i will be gone. i am so much of a shell right now, i do not belong to myself. like, i am outside of myself. hmm. this isn’t a depression shitpost, just how i feel. i said in my voice notes the other day that the smell is back. that smell, ugh. i cannot describe it. it’s like right in the centre of my nasal passage and only comes in periods of deep depression. i don’t know if that is a thing, but every single time i have been at my lowest, this smell is present. let me google. nothing came up.

hmm. the eve of 25 feels weird. i have always been relatively excited to enter a new era of a new age. but this year feels a little different - like, this is that last year of my life as i know it? maybe it’s a presumption, maybe it’s preempting. but, it’s that last ‘young’ year. 25 is the last year i can justify not fully adulting and that’s really fucking scary. i feel like it should be a year of getting my shit together. but i wish it was anything but.

first text post of 2018. it feels surreal to be writing that year. knowing i’m turning 20 and knowing i’m in my best place and my worst place at the same time. all things considered, i’m doing well. i’m thinking positive. 

i saw my sixth form friends properly for the first time in since starting second year and it was lovely and sad and i realise now how much more of an effort i need to make to stay in contact with these girls that listened to my problems for three entire years. maybe i’m a different person to when we were spending every day together but it wouldn’t be right to let them go. i cannot imagine my life without them. 

i’m on the train back home and in such a liminal space my mind is racing. walking home alone in cambridge always gets me thinking. such a peaceful city while my head won’t stay still. stuck between two cities. caught between leicester and cambridge creates such confusion. comfort of home and friends and a town i am so familiar with, structure of work and responsibility fulfilling my life somewhat with a purpose. and then leicester. such hustle and bustle, going where i want when i want. smoking and drinking red wine. getting high and watching the buzz of the amber street lights that feel so nostalgic when i walk home at midnight with my make up half-mucked and my feet hurting. 
maybe my problem is that even when i’m at my happiest, there is a weight in my heart that is so willing to pull me under, so needy of the lull of sadness that takes over my body, but is almost wanted. thriving from the depths of a darkness that not even i can quite understand. 

this took a different turn to what i initially came to write. 
i wanted to write about how i feel at home with my friends but at the same time so alienated, as if i’ve missed an entire chapter of their lives, and as if i’m an inactive participant of my own.

- She who dares, wins!
- Big opportunities and changes coming your way
- Be focused, honest and ambitious
- Your imagination will help you achieve independence: cultivate your talents and start working on improvement
- Seek the company of those who love and truly care about you
- Pay particular attention to relationships and romantic relationships. Be bold, but be honest and trust each other. 

1. Fears (underworld)

Zero The Fool: New beginnings, the future, beginner’s luck
- Zero: the number of unlimited potential.
- Take things as they are. Settle outstanding disagreements
- This is a good time to work independently and build up your life

it is time to start thinking about new years’ resolutions. i just looked through my goals for this year and had only completed a mere half. 
and yet this year has been an interesting one, if strange. socially, i have grown, emotionally i have perhaps developed but i have left less time for myself in that i cannot remember the last time i wrote in a journal, or the last time i read for an entire day. i have become extremely focused on external motives which perhaps is something to work on again for next year. i’ve also accomplished a lot i am proud of. i have moved into a house with three girls i adore, i have cut and slowed toxic friendships, i completed an entire year of university without giving up. i’m still breathing. i spend more of my time out of the house than in; i do not lock myself away in my room. i have also, although i hate to admit, had extremely low and distinctive lows, but maybe it is what i needed. i take things with a pinch of salt and sometimes i am not quite sure if that is for better or for worse. but since i am so lazy to write in a journal, i am composing a list here which i suppose makes it more editable. i shall perhaps write it down for a later date. 
i am so aware that each year the same resolutions turn up on my list. maybe that makes me a failure? maybe they are unattainable? or maybe they just weren’t for the right time. 

and so here it is. my list of 2018 resolutions.

- meditate multiple times weekly. reset my mental health and find a habit that is beneficial for my wellbeing.
- stop resorting to self-harm as a form of coping mechanism. let’s see if we can go an entire year without it.
- dance more. dance alone in your room, late at night. dance at clubs with your friends. dance as often as you can.
- read. take ten minutes of your time to sit and read something that is not compulsory.
- write. what better way to perfect a skill? write poems. write journal entries. write stories.
- journal. when you are old and reminiscent, how beautiful would it be to be able to relive your youth?
- be more outgoing. speak in seminars, laugh louder in public spaces. hell, cry in front of your friends. you are here on earth for a short time, and you might as well be the best, and biggest you that you can be. 
- nurture the friendships that are good for me. but stop overthinking and worrying about getting rid of people that are detrimental for your health. 
- do well in second year. you’ve made it this far so you might as well make it worth it. 
- love unconditionally, love wholly and love fully, yet don’t be taken for granted.
- explore! you have an entire world around you. the stars, the sky, the sea. be adventurous, be spontaneous. go. what better time is there than now?

i wrote a lot last night though. more so than i have in a while and it was cathartic and needed. i wrote a list of bad memories and i think a lot of them explain my awful communication and why i am the way i am. why i withdraw instead of seeking help and why i react so badly to confrontation. because it’s engrained in me that if i speak about my feelings there will be awful consequences.

because my life is good. i have a mere few days until university is over, i am in love, i have good friends. but this nagging sadness always creeps back to me. 
and i think a lot of it is because i am ashamed. i’m ashamed of myself, i’m embarrassed and i feel guilty all of the time. it’s like imposter syndrome. i’ve been living in my head. i’ve been talking to myself excessively and is it because i feel as though i have no one else to talk to? or is it because i have so many feelings i don’t know where to put them?

and yet again, the inconsistency of my writing continues to amaze me. that, and the fact that every entry still contains the same depressing thoughts that are killing my brain and self-worth. 

i’ve had a weird couple of months. work has been draining every living blood cell in me, i am suffocating under my parent’s roof, and i am waiting on jobs that i think i want but are not exactly what i want. it’s all a big waiting game and i have little control over it. my head is having a big wild fucking party because of this. we all know how brilliant i am at overthinking. but mainly, i really want to cry. but i can never seem to get that far. it feels like something is stopping me. 

i feel extremely restricted, conflicted. i have lost sight of everything i have wanted and what i am striving for. it’s safe to say i am losing myself and i am losing grip on reality.
my head is all over the place, and nothing i do seems to control it. if i’m not stressing about my career, i am stressing about my relationship or my social life or something or other. replacing replacements and never sourcing the problem.

so, here we are again. another dire attempt at sorting my life out, hopefully to some avail this time. i’m just going around in circles, really. never quite sure what i am doing. maybe that’s the problem. i have no. fucking. clue. what i am doing.

part of me hopes i get the troubador job. but i also have a very nagging, discontent, side of my brain that is telling me that i don’t need the job and the rejection will be the kick up the arse that i need to just quit work, quit my current life and go ‘find myself’ in the midst of the amazon or the busy streets of india. any excuse to up and leave, i will take. at this point, i just want to travel and live anywhere but home. i’d probably suit the nomad lifestyle; doing what i want, when i want and finding some way to live on the dregs that i call my bank account. start up a blog because really, who doesn’t want to read such riveting entries as these? i’d make a bloody fortune.

another part of me, the depressed side of me, really wants to hide in bed. for a month or so. then rise with matted hair and ghostly skin, up through the ashes and start over. a few thoughts of just topping myself, i won’t lie, have entered my mind. but the train of death and despair has (hopefully) long gone from the land of my life, choo-chooing in the far distance. at least, i like to tell myself. but i’ve been good at keeping those thoughts at bay recently and would quite like to keep it that way.

the thing is, i am a very ambitious person. or at least i used to be. i am constantly thinking up new things and new ways of life but yet, i’m still here. there’s a real disconnect between my ambition and my motivation. and an even larger one between that and my initiative. like i’m only half here? not quite present and not fully focused. i put too much on my plate, take more than i can chew, and any other euphemism for extreme behaviour that inevitably results in lack of action.

but how have i got this so wrong? i’m thinking of too many things i want to be, too many personalities i want to embody that i have somehow completely lost site of myself. really i just want to write a list of things i would like my life to be but we all know that i have written at least four of those in the last 30 days and for some strange reason, none of it is turning out to be appearing nonchalantly in my life. maybe, ███████, lists do not just miraculously appear. maybe you actually have to embark on the journey of ticking them off.

it’s not like i haven’t tried. i have. just obviously not hard enough. i somehow always seem to find an obstacle in the way. a big one is money, which i cannot change, but surely there is a way around that. i really want(██) to make something out of the copywriting and website business i thought about starting. but i only got as far as half-creating my own website. i think because it didn’t feel real enough to put any more time into it. but i made the initial step to extend my free trial today. so maybe something will come of it.

i think what i really wish i had done was take the gap year that i promised myself i would take after uni. not that it would solve all my problems, but it would take the pressure off the transition between uni and a job. it is definitely something i regret because travel has always been a source of happiness, freedom and mindfulness for me. and there is definitely an itch i need to scratch. i don’t want to be in the rat race for the rest of my life. it’s not something that aligns with me and is not something i want to be a part of. 

 
so, what’s the take from this note? absolutely fuck all, it seems. apart from the fact that i somehow messed up the few months of freedom i had by working overtime at monsoon and stressing myself out continuously over the fact that i don’t have a real job even though i don’t actually want a real job. just sums up my life really, constantly creating problems that i don’t realise i don’t have. what a riveting journey of words. until the next mental breakdown.

and the boy i love is on the other side of the world on an impromptu business trip. and it’s hard. because i can’t match the spontaneity because i don’t have the funds or the company. 
i miss when things were new and he didn’t have so much money. when things were simpler and he’d text me every morning before 10am and he’d text me goodnight every night without fail. i miss the simplicity of being in bed and having his full attention and not answering his phone. 
don’t get me wrong. i love him more than life itself, he is my life and my world and everything in between.
my favorite scent is his. i love to wear his clothes when he isn’t around because i can smell him when he isn’t here. and that first time we have contact after not seeing him always hits me. his scent is my home and i bury my head in his neck or his chest any moment i can. 
and when we are together things are good. more than good. he makes me feel so loved but sometimes he is so distant and so involved with work and his phone that it becomes hard. it’s hard because when we arent together, he won’t text me often but i know that he’s constantly online and on his phone. 
i won’t deny that i can be needy but he is my boyfriend. it’s hard to know that he is so independent that maybe if i wasn’t here he wouldn’t be that much different.
i think i’m struggling a lot with everything. i have a lot of decisions and a lot of changes to think about. and if i want to be with him for the rest of my life i need to think hard about this. 
the thing is, i don’t care about the money. i don’t care about the material world that he has and he owns. all i want is for him to be there for me, to be consistent and to love me even when i’m not in the same room as him. no, not to love me, because i know he does with every inch of his heart. but for him to *show* me. for him to consistently remind me that he is here for me out of choice, for him to text me first or ask to see me without me arranging it beforehand. for him to be present when he’s with me. to make me more of a priority and to communicate with me. 
gosh i love him so much. i cannot contain my love for this man. i do see a future with him, i see myself spending the rest of my life with him but i am scared that he is on a path where he doesn’t see me in it. 
this isn’t about trust because i trust him with all of my heart. but i need more communication if we are going to build a life together. i feel like i am always the last to know, only hear half of the story and i feel like i’m living my life around his choices and his decisions. i need balance. not just with him but with everything.

i feel like my room has a lot of clutter and there are a lot of different energies that surround my belongings, which i think is what is hindering me slightly. it’s hard to get rid of stuff because everything seems to have such a significant past. i feel better for having cleared my desk slightly.

i’m in a dark place. i hope it is temporary. today i deleted my social media accounts until my last exam next tuesday. i am hoping it will give me some headspace and more time to revise. i want to use my spare time to write here and sort my fucking head out. i’m all over the place. the past few days have had an underlying wave of sadness and it finally hit me. i spent the past hour lying in my bed because i didn’t have the energy to do anything. i really need to cry, but i am too tired. i should probably eat something. i will probably drink wine in a bit. 

	i feel like a fake. i feel like i am shit and not worthy or deserving of anything i have. i feel like i am annoying, needy, too much and too little at the same time. i’m listening to my depressing playlist on spotify and i noticed that each time i added a bulk load of songs was in the months of may and june, for the past 5 years. is it coincidental? 

a lot of things about myself are bothering me. i feel as though everyone hates me. i feel stupid and possessive and boring. i feel angsty and i feel like i am too rude and ignorant. and i don’t know how to change any of this and if i need to change. i have completely lost sight of who i am and what i stand for and i feel like everything i have worked for is disappearing and i feel as though the world as i know it is falling below my feet. 

	and i feel excessive. i feel like i am exaggerating but how do i stop? i am so stupid for worrying over such silly, incessant things. what does any of it matter anyway? i haven’t felt this way in a while. i don’t want to do anything stupid tonight. i just feel so lonely. at this moment i really hate who i am and who i have become. i don’t write, i don’t draw, i can’t fucking communicate and i am completely and utterly shit and undeserving of everything i have. jesus fuck. am i really so dramatic to have not written in such a long time and then come out with this load of shit? 

	i was productive today. i went to the coffee shop and did a solid three hours of work. but i also knew that this was coming, it was looming over me like a grey fucking cloud. could i use any more cliches in one piece of writing?

	i’ve lost focus, lost creativity, lost myself. i’m in need of a big fucking epiphany if i am to get through this weekend. i didn’t realise how much of a crutch social media had become to completely distance my body from my brain and be such a distraction for my mental health. turns out if you turn off the device you start to feel a hell of a lot more. which i wasn’t expecting. i just felt completely overwhelmed by technology and myself. and this morning i opened youtube and the first video was about switching off social media so i took it as a calling. it’s probably for the best. 

	have i just been feeling like this all this time and it’s just suddenly resurfaced? what was the trigger? why the fuck do i have so many questions? i’ve been obsessive, impulsive, compulsive, every fucking negative thing for these past few weeks that all i can say is i am ashamed of myself.

	and i am trying to be more honest with ██████. but i feel so fucking idiotic about it because when he asks if i am okay for the 500th time and my reply is i just feel a bit sad, with absolutely no evidence or reasoning it just feels as though i am making it up for attention. but something is wrong and i can’t figure out what the fuck it is and i am scared that i am falling back to my old silly habits and i just don’t know how to deal with that. and it’s hard because i love him so much but i am scared that i am being nit-picky and one day he’s just going to pack up his bags and leave because i am too much to handle and i don’t deal with anything very well at all. 

	i’m just really fucking scared. all the goddamn time. i felt so anxious yesterday for no actual reason. even stupid things, i couldn’t go up to ask for the fucking wifi password because my brain is telling me i am not capable of doing something like that, so i spent the entire morning wasting my data on something that could have been free. i am so in my head. how the fuck do i get out? i really thought that after 8 fucking years i would get over all of this ‘i feel like shit’ crap. turns out it doesn’t go away that easily. 30 days make a habit. i have had a hell of a lot more time than that.

	maybe i have just been burying my feelings and not dealing with them. i know i pile things up both physically and mentally. maybe i should start being more honest with myself. but i have been feeling really good recently, that isn’t a lie. so when i do feel like this i feel like it is fake. but it also feels like home. and that worries me. i think that’s maybe why i don’t get so het up on feeling sad because it’s better to let it pass, if i don’t think about my feelings then they won’t be overwhelming. if i dwell on being sad then what if i stay sad? 

	for the past couple of days, while i’ve had company, all that i’ve been doing is having conversations in my head. and i should have taken that as a fucking sign because why the hell am i having full blown conversations with myself when there is someone right next to me? and i know that when i feel like this i either go overboard or i completely blank out and lose track but either way i exhaust myself. i should have known this was coming. but why did it have to be now? and the worst thing is that when this happens i hurt the people i love. i distance myself and withdraw and i feel out of control so i just shut down. i feel so childish, immature. i never learnt to talk about my feelings because every time i ever did there were consequences and i got shut down so now it’s just easier to shut myself down instead. so i switch off. go fucking silent, m.i.a., because that’s the normal fucking way to deal with things isn’t it. i feel like a joke. like a fake.

	i feel as though i need to work through some kind of trauma but i don’t know what the trauma is. i don’t know how to solve this. i’m going to try and re-visit memories that i constantly think about:

- i remember when i felt depressed in secondary school and my friend told me to tell someone. so i went to my teacher and he said if i didn’t go to the school nurse he would tell my parents. i really tried to go to the nurse but the thought of talking to a stranger held me back. i physically could not walk to that office. so he called my parents and told them everything, even when he promised he wouldn’t because of confidentiality 
- i remember having so many conversations at that point with my parents. i remember my dad looking at me with disgust. i remember when he asked me where i got my blades from and who i was copying. the first thing that came to his mind was that i was copying someone. that i was doing it for attention. 
- i remember when he looked me dead in the eyes, got a knife from the drawer and told me to cut myself in front of him. i remember when i said no, and said i wanted to leave that he said if i left the room he would never talk to me again. i left the room. we have not had anything but small talk since 
- i remember when my mother made me take my trousers and shirt off so she could inspect my body. she never looked at my thighs. she asked me to never do it again. she never asked why i ever did.
- i remember every morning in the car my mother would ask us how we felt out of ten. if it was anything below 7 she said there was no reason to feel that way. i remember when i said when the weather is bad i sometimes felt bad too. she told me i was stupid 
- i remember being suicidal and self-harming and all my mother could tell me was ‘how does it make me feel as a parent? you have a good life so why would you do this to me?’ 
- i remember when i came out as bisexual on the internet. on my own, private blog. i remember my mother stalking my blog and confronting telling me it was a phase and that she would be awfully upset if she were to never have grandchildren.
- i remember my mother going through my belongings and reading my journals. i remember her then telling me about what she read
- i remember being bullied horrifically online at school. i remember watching people look at me and whisper about me. i never understood why because i never said anything mean to anyone
- i remember getting anonymous hate online every single day saying i smelt, i was ugly, i was disgusting, that my sexuality was wrong, that no one liked me. those words never left me 
- i remember when someone cheated on me for the first time. i remember thinking it was my fault
- i remember when i was cheated on again later in life. i remember his uncaring attitude towards me. i remember my feelings being unvalidated and i remember the feeling of my heart dropping. i remember getting so drunk and high in the middle of the day while my parents were out. i remember having to tell my parents what happened. i remember my mum telling me ‘that’s life’, and to not get into things so quickly. i remember the lack of comfort i felt, to just forget about it
- i remember when i told my mother i was thinking about writing a poetry book she said that no one i know will want to read it because how would my grandparents feel if they saw how i felt? that my words have consequences and that no one should be able to see how sad i am. 
- i remember being told not to cut, being told not to drink, not to smoke, not to sleep around or talk to boys. i don’t remember ever being asked if there was a reason

i worked today, finished my second week at my new job. it’s been okay. pretty mundane but i like the routine and it’s good money for saving for… canada. my visa just got approved which is so SO exciting but also intensely nerve wracking. i’m essentially starting a new life in a new place, knowing completely no one. but i’ve done it before. and i’ll do it again. i think it’s good for me. if not now, when? 

i’m on the train home so as we know this is the perfect contemplation time. we love a round up of happenings here. 

i met with the anthro girls after work today and it was just really fucking wholesome. i can’t believe i’ve met friends as good as them, they’re strong women independently and we feel so good as a group. and we couldn’t be more different. i’m heading to milan next week with █████. and isn’t it funny to think that had i not had this horrible thing i went through, i would never have had the pleasure of meeting them? the girls that i would now consider my favourite group, the girls i hope will be in my life forever? 

goes to show that shit happens for a reason. i’ve stopped thinking that i need to plan my whole life. shit, i thought i’d be married by 25, kids by 27. career in full steam. but in a way, i think i am better off without that plan. yes, it would have been ideal. but i’ve been thinking: is it my ideal, or a generational ideal? a societal ideal? one hammered into my brains so much that i take it as my own. 

had the Break Up not happened, i would never have found myself in this position. shit, i would have been stuck in an unhappy relationship (or a marriage), with no aspiration and the expectation to be a housewife. oh to think i loved someone so blindly that i was a housewife before i had a ring on my finger. no, infatuated. obsessed? it was love, and there always will be. but there was this underlying tone, an essence, if you will, of… misogyny? of expectation? i can’t quite put a word on it. but, the expectation that i was meant to stay in the home. be the  traditional female role. look after the dog, clean the kitchen. ring his clothes. all while he was out with his friends, making excuses to come home late and preferring to go to the pub with a mate rather than a drink with me. i was blindsided. 

not to say it was all bad. in fact, it was actually good. really good. but hindsight is a terrible thing and you start unpicking, picking, picking. picking all the bits that might have been a sign if you looked hard enough. a sign of the past. of love of infatuation… of what ifs and what could have been and why’s? 

i suppose after six months of learning about myself, there’s still more that lies untold. yet to explore. perhaps i’ll dig up a couple more skeletons before i can finally lay this to bed. i think my way of dealing has been good for the most part. i spent maybe a few weeks crying and besotted with heartbreak. i quickly got a job to put my energy elsewhere. i made new relationships to discuss the pain. i uncovered a lot of hurt. my body holds trauma. it wasn’t just a clean break up. dubai can officially be named as Trauma with a capital T (which needs to be dealt with) and so can the end of the relationship. a capital T for not having access to a dog that was my love and passion. a T for the financial loss. a T for the dependency on another human. 

but the growth i have had is enormous. the anxiety i had while in that relationship? gone. my lack of being able to do things for myself? gone. isolation? none. i am a free woman. i am, in fact, a wild woman. free, untamed, an enigma. 

i’m way past the sorrow and guilt phase. anger comes and goes. i’m in the mindset of if it’s meant to be it would have been, and it wasn’t. things happen for a reason and i’m happy with my life right now. 

a side note. we were asking which foods we were tonight. maddy said i was tomato soup. i asked why and she said it’s because i’m warm and homely. it’s one of the nicest things anyone ever said to me.
